name: Twitch
description: Watch Twitch streams with controller navigation and pinnable webapp windows. Sign-in is needed for chat and account features; playback and pop-outs depend on Twitch's WebView2 compatibility.

name: Discord
description: Use Discord's web app with controller input and pinnable pop-outs. Requires Discord sign-in; website microphone and camera access are controlled separately.

name: Game Help
description: Ask for game hints with screenshots and clips. Requires your own Gemini API key. Capture and saved-media access are requested when needed.

name: Display Profiles
description: Save and restore monitor layouts, resolutions and refresh rates. Display changes use a timed confirmation with automatic rollback.

name: Playnite Library
description: Browse and launch your Playnite games. Requires the separate Playnite Bridge extension and a running Playnite instance.

name: Spotify
description: Browse your Spotify library and control playback with your controller. Spotify sign-in and provider setup are required.

name: YouTube Video
description: Search and watch YouTube with a pinnable player. Searching requires a YouTube API key; video links can play without a search key.

name: YouTube Music
description: Browse music and keep playback controls pinned while playing. Sign-in may be required.
